sn46.17:1.1: “Bhikkhus, these seven factors of enlightenment, when developed and cultivated, lead to going beyond from the near shore to the far shore.
sn46.17:1.3: The enlightenment factor of mindfulness … the enlightenment factor of equanimity.
sn46.17:1.4: These seven factors of enlightenment, when developed and cultivated, lead to going beyond from the near shore to the far shore.”
sn46.17:5.2: (The verses attached to this sutta are identical with those at SN45.34 above.)
